goal: Stop intermittent CI failures in the HTTP receive-throttle regression test
Prevent test flakiness caused by platform-specific TCP socket heuristics
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile as nothing invalidates review
agreement: Support because the testing approach is much more reliable than socket backpressure (davidgumberg)
Verified by testing that the check passes on tip and fails with unthrottled reads (151henry151)
Nonblocking objection: test failure timeout is too generous at five minutes (davidgumberg)
Suggests using explicit thread events for synchronization and faster teardown (winterrdog)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it resolves intermittent functional test failures without changing public RPC behavior
The fix improves CI reliability across platforms, especially on macOS
